ratios.quote: Under the Credit Agreement, we are required to maintain as of the end of each fiscal quarter a consolidated interest coverage ratio of not less than 3.0 to 1.0 and a consolidated leverage ratio of not greater than 3.5 to 1.0.

parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The 3.0x pro forma leverage condition for Restricted Payments and the leverage-based pricing grid are excluded because they are not maintenance covenants.
